text: Three pid runs were compared on 24 September over the same 11,187 true pairs: ANCIENT at ../old-nail-benchmarks/pct-id-benchmark, OLDCOPY (the pre-reversal code at ac252c2) run in tmp-claude/pid-old, and NEW. ANCIENT and OLDCOPY agree within 0.01 of recall at 1% FPR and 0.02 per identity bin, so the refactor moved nothing but the decoys and rejection.
